data.say: Think of one over. Bowl 3 balls of it and you've bowled 3/6 of the over, which is the same as 1/2, because 3/6 = 1/2 when you divide the top and bottom by 3. That's all an equivalent fraction is: the same share of the over, written with different numbers. Your turn: after 4 balls of the over, which fraction is that, and which simpler fraction equals it?

note: spoken line corrected by hand on 2026-09-05 after the teaching review; the board is the product's own pipelines' work and every sum in the line is signed by its CAS
